title: metadata-protocol: a seed load that throws mid-batch drops the landed row ids of the datasets that landed before the throw, so the publish receipt carries no seedApplied.landed
body:
domain:spec#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzfgvGexKn9vLHsy89K

Filing gate: ③ carried from the contract review of PR #30427 (#30348), so that PR stays at the shape the card named. ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested-grade: p2, because cloud's "clear sample data" reads `seedApplied.landed` to know which rows a seed created, and after a partial publish it has no ids for the datasets that did land. Route: `domain:spec` (packages/metadata-protocol).

**What happens.** PR #30427 adds `seedApplied.landed = [{ object, inserted, matched }]` to the publish receipt. `applySeedBodies` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-publish-batch.ts`) fills it only on the returned-load path. When the loader throws partway through a batch, the catch returns counts from `seedLoadPartialWrites`, and `SeedLoadPartialWrites` carries counts only, so the receipt has `success: false` and no `landed` at all, although earlier datasets in the batch did insert rows. PR #30427's body says the receipt reports this as "not reported", and cloud must read an absent `landed` next to `success: false` as unknown.

**Why.** The partial-writes record was shaped before the receipt carried ids. The loader already knows each landed dataset's `insertedIds` and `landedIds` when it throws on a later one.

## Wanted

- [ ] Measure at `origin/main` after PR #30427 lands: where the loader throws mid-batch, which per-dataset results already exist, and what `seedLoadPartialWrites` reads.
- [ ] Carry the landed datasets' ids through the partial-writes path so the receipt's `landed` lists them (the same projection and the same 200 cap), and say in the schema description that a thrown load's `landed` covers only datasets that finished.
- [ ] Pins at a real door: a good seed lands and a later seed throws; the receipt lists the good seed's inserted ids and omits the failing one.

Not in scope: whether the ownership claim (`claim-seed-ownership.ts`, `seed-settlement.ts`) should narrow from `landedIds` to `insertedIds`; that is a separate ruling.

Blocked-by: #30348
